## Description

Brief description of the feature or improvement.

What problem does this feature solve? What is the use case?

## Alternative Solutions

Are there alternative approaches or solutions?

## Benefits

What are the benefits of this feature?

- [ ] Affects assessment methodology

- [ ] Affects tooling
- [ ] Other

## Priority

## Related Issues

Link to related issues if applicable.

## Additional Context

Any additional context or information that might be helpful.
